task.title: Diagnose Build 52 real-device HealthKit self-heal failure

result.summary: Neither Activity nor Nutrition was permanently stuck on Build 52 -- both self-healed, confirmed by the Founder's own live updates. Root cause: a Server-side idempotency-key insert race producing spurious 500s on app relaunch, plus a normal usage-cadence gap. Fixed server-side, independently reviewed (2 gaps found and hardened), tested and mutation-tested. Also fixed the raw-floating-point display bug on both Evidence Reports and added Log pull-to-refresh, per the Founder's follow-up reports. Founder explicitly authorized both production actions; Server fix deployed and verified, Build 53 uploaded and Apple-confirmed VALID.

tests.summary: Server: foundation 38/38, phase2 97/97, phase4 137/137, phase3 273/274 (1 pre-existing unrelated fixture failure, confirmed present before any change in this task). Native: 1289/1289 PhysiqueOSTests. All new tests (8 Server, 2 Native) mutation-tested -- reverted production code only, confirmed each new test fails with exactly the error it exists to catch, restored, confirmed byte-identical to before revert.

review.summary: Two independent adversarial reviews (Server fix, Native fixes), both fresh-context with no shared state. Server review found two real gaps (non-arbiter-constraint 23505 edge case; identical unguarded pattern on outbox.insert in the same file) -- both fixed in a follow-up commit, re-verified, no further findings. Native review confirmed the float-display fix and pull-to-refresh cache-key set are correct, and surfaced one genuine-but-out-of-scope completeness gap (3 other non-HealthKit raw-double leak sites) spun off as a separate follow-up task rather than expanding this one, plus one non-defect nuance (bootstrap()'s outcome can say 'caught up' when nothing new actually landed; harmless here since this pull-to-refresh discards that outcome and just reloads canonical state either way).

zero_write_audit.summary: Server deploy: fast-forward merge only (no conflicts -- combined-app-platform-cutover's HEAD was exactly this fix's base commit), no schema/migration change, build logs show a clean Next.js restart with no migration executed, health endpoints both 200 immediately after. Verified the deployment's own spec JSON reports source_commit_hash matching the exact reviewed commit, not a stale one (the known 'env-only update reuses old commit' gotcha). Native upload: archive re-verified unchanged before --execute, no credential material read/printed/logged (API key referenced only by path).

decisions_required: Founder: install Build 53 from TestFlight normally (no canary, no manual Sync) and confirm the real-device retest: Activity and Nutrition should now catch up without the occasional spurious 500 (fixed at the root), the raw-float display should be gone from both Evidence Reports, and Log's new pull-to-refresh should force an immediate catch-up on demand.

Two follow-up tasks were spawned as separate session suggestions (chips), not started: (1) fix the same raw-double-leak pattern at 3 other non-HealthKit sites (Training exercise history, Training Logger's editable reps/load field, photo-scanned nutrition prefill); (2) investigate whether the idempotency fix's new lock-wait behavior under a retry burst is a real connection-pool risk given actual traffic patterns, or a non-issue.

Process gap: this task's own prompt file was directly git-committed to five times after being claimed, bypassing the handoff tool's immutability gate (confirmed benign -- all from the Founder's own git identity, matching in-chat 'review this' instructions -- but the immutability guarantee is currently only enforced by the publish tool, not the repository itself).
unexpected_findings: The prompt-file immutability violation described above.
Two additional hardening gaps found by independent review of the Server fix, both closed before deployment (see validation.review).
backlog: Fix the same raw-double-leak pattern at TrainingReadModel.formatNumber, TrainingLoggerView's editable reps/load field, and EvidenceLocalInterpretation.formatNutritionNumber (spawned as a separate task).
Investigate command_receipts lock-wait cost under a retry burst against real pool size/traffic (spawned as a separate task).
Auto-foreground 'stale after N minutes' threshold policy -- deliberately deferred; the Founder asked this be derived from measured query/upload cost, and no such telemetry exists yet.
Close the prompt-file immutability gap in the handoff protocol itself (currently enforced only by the publish tool, not the repository).

Carried from the prior handoff: wire abandonedBatchCount into a circuit breaker/backoff for generic permanent rejections; namespace daily-aggregate deletions before deletion delivery ships; surface diagnostics fields in the Founder diagnostic screen.
recommended_next_step: Founder: install Build 53 from TestFlight, do not enable canary or press manual Sync, open the app normally, and confirm Activity/Nutrition catch up cleanly (optionally using the new Log pull-to-refresh to force an immediate check) with no raw floating-point numbers on either Evidence Report.
